पुट् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (पटति)
1 To embrace,
clasp.
--2 To intertwine. {vII.v} {c10c} U.
(पुटयति-ते)
1 To be in contact with.
--2 To bind together, fasten.
--3
(पोटयति-ते) (a) To grind, reduce
to powder. (b) To speak. (c) To
shine. {vIII.v} {c1c} P. (पोटति)
1 To grind.
--2 To rub.

पुट्ट् {c10c} U. (पुट्टयति-त)
1 To
become small, decrease, diminish.
--2
To be low or shallow.
--3 To
disregard, disrespect.

पुटः --टं [पुट्-क]
1 A fold.
--2 A
hollow space, cavity, concavity;
भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वन निलः

; अंजलिपट,
नासापुट, कर्णपुट &c.
--3 A cup made of a
leaf folded or doubled; a vessel of
leaves; दुग्ध्वा पयः पत्रपुटे मदीयं
Ms. 6

.-8.
--4 Any shallow
receptacle.
--5 The pod or capsule
which envelops young shoots.
--6
A sheath, cover, covering.
--7 An
eyelid. (पुटी also in all these senses)
--8 A horse's hoof.
--टः
1 A casket.
--2 The contracting of anything.
--3
A folding of anything so as to form
a cup.
--टं
1 A nutmeg.
--2 Two
vessels joined together for medical
purposes.
--Comp.
--उटजं a white
umbrella.
--उदकः a cocoa-nut.
--ग्रीवः {1} a pot, jar, pitcher. {2} a
copper-vessel.
--पाकः {1} a particular
method of preparing drugs, in
which the various ingredients are
wrapped up in leaves, and being
covered with clay are roasted in
the fire: अनिर्भिन्नो
गभीरत्वादंतर्गूढघनव्यथः । पुटपाकप्रतीकाशो रामस्य करुणो
रसः

. {4} a whirl-pool
or eddy.
--भेदनं a town, city;
Śi. 13. 26.
